summary: Tonix Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting a commercial agreement with a group purchasing organization (GPO) that provides coverage for its product TONMYA to approximately 35 million U.S. commercially insured individuals effective May 1, 2026. The filing also notes existing Medicaid coverage in 38 states covering 55 million beneficiaries. No specific deal terms, price, premium, or board recommendation are mentioned. This is a routine commercial coverage announcement, not a special situation, and contains only forward-looking statements.
